October 2004 Lists:
The '''October 2004 Forbidden and Limited Lists''' were Forbidden and Limited lists in the ''[[TCG]]'', going into effect on October 1, [[2004]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.pojo.com/yu-gi-oh/PriceGuide/Banned-Restricted-List.shtml | title = Forbidden and Limited List - October 2004. | archiveurl = https://web.archive.org/web/20041204091244/http://www.pojo.com/yu-gi-oh/PriceGuide/Banned-Restricted-List.shtml | archivedate = December 4, 2004 | accessdate = May 14, 2017 }}</ref>

This list updated the previous [[August 2004 Lists|August 2004 list]] which had announced in advance that 13 cards were going to change status from [[Limited]] to [[Forbidden]], starting October 1. But in addition to that, once October 1 came by, another 5 cards were declared Limited as well.

The first major event to enforce this list, [[Pharaoh Tour Stuttgart 2004]], happened on September 18, two weeks prior to the lists' official starting date. This was an unusual decision made to ensure that all [[Pharaoh Tour]] 2004 tournaments would adhere to the new [[Advanced Format]] uniformly.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.etcg.de/forum/index.php?thread/110111-spieler-der-pharao-tour-aufgepa%C3%9Ft/&pageNo=1|title=Spieler der Pharao Tour aufgepaßt!!|trans-title=Attention Pharaoh Tour players!!|author=((Mew2))|publisher=eTCG|date=September 12, 2004|language=German}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kidszone.de/?menu=0301|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20041009193120/http://www.kidszone.de/?menu=0301|archivedate=October 9, 2004|title=Yu-Gi-Oh!
